{{Quote|Arriving starships must approach Dulin starport from the southern approach vector. The northern approach vector will be temporarily closed from 2500 to 2700 hours for a fireworks display as part of the city's celebration of the New Year Fete Week. Contact your starport controller on comm channel UN-271 for further approach vector and traffic pattern information.|Dulin METOSP|<ref name="Platt's Starport Guide">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''UN-271''' was a comm channel utilized by the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] controller at [[Dulin starport]] to transmit [[METOSP/Legends|METOSPs]] to incoming [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] traffic.
